Fixture for the regulated-claims firing tests. `landing.md` is a
product page draft for a cushion, written the way a draft arrives:
a physiological effect stated as a result, a No.1 line with no basis,
a before and after, a customer testimonial carrying the efficacy
claim, a named competitor comparison, a reference price nobody paid,
a chart lifted from someone else's report, and a named customer with
a photo. `notes.md` records what the team actually has.
